description:
Rank AI build tools by a single metric from Vibe Shipped listings.

Use when: the user asks which AI tool has the most shipped apps, the most stated revenue, or is trending. For full stats without ranking use list_tools.

Behavior: Read-only. by = count (listed apps), revenue (total stated monthly USD), median (median stated monthly USD) or trending (new listings in the last 30 days). Revenue is as stated by makers, not audited.

Example: {"by":"revenue","limit":5}
name: top_tools
title: Top AI build tools
